disclosure.title: What happens to the chat
disclosure.parsed: The export is read and checked in this browser. Nothing is uploaded until you press Import.
disclosure.selected: Only the messages you keep are uploaded. The chat name and the zip file stay on this device.
disclosure.held: Messages with ID numbers, bank details, passwords or sensitive keywords are held back.
disclosure.voice: Voice notes are kept as files and are not transcribed.
disclosure.access: CauseDeck never reads your contacts or notifications, and never connects to WhatsApp.
disclosure.retention: The chat text is deleted 30 days after its tasks are extracted, unless you pin it.

chatType.legend: What kind of chat is this?
chatType.internalHint: Chambers, juniors, clerks or co-counsel. No clients in it.
chatType.clientHint: A client is in the chat.
chatType.unsureHint: I can't tell who is in it.
chatType.stopTitle: Client conversations stay out of CauseDeck imports for now
chatType.stopBody: Nothing was read or uploaded. Your file never left this device.

warning.clientTitle: This looks like a client conversation
warning.clientBody: These participants look like clients: {names}. Client conversations stay out of CauseDeck imports for now. Nothing was uploaded.
warning.twoTitle: Only two people, and neither is you
warning.twoBody: A chat between two people who are not you is often a client's. Is every participant part of your chambers?

file.label: WhatsApp export
file.hint: Export the chat from WhatsApp without media (or with it), then choose the .zip or .txt file here.

preview.title: Choose the messages to import
preview.summary: {kept, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} selected of {total}
preview.limit: {max} messages is the most one import can hold. Unselect some to continue.
preview.keys: Arrow keys move, Space includes or excludes, C confirms a held message.
preview.dateOrder: Dates read as day/month. Flip if they look wrong.
preview.dateOrderAmbiguous: These dates could be day/month or month/day.

upload.submit: Import {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}
upload.done: Imported. CauseDeck is reading the chat. Proposals will appear in your inbox.

failed.forbidden: You are not allowed to import chats in this workspace.
failed.too_large: The chat is too large to import. Unselect some messages.
failed.invalid: The server did not accept these messages. Check the selection and try again.
failed.rate_limited: Too many imports just now. Try again in a minute.
failed.failed: The upload failed. Nothing was imported. Try again.

states.empty: No messages to import yet. Choose an export file to begin.
states.offline: You're offline. You can read and choose messages, but importing needs a connection.
states.denied: Only owners and advocates can import chats.

error.not_zip: That file is not a valid zip export.
error.no_chat: No chat text was found in the zip.
error.too_large: That export is too large. Export without media and try again.
error.empty: No importable messages were found in that file.
error.failed: The export could not be read. Try exporting it again.
